Pre-FEED Study 5 DE-FE0031937 / 0001 Subtask 4.4 Permitting Study and Review Dastur has assessed the impact of generated waste released along with the mitigation measures with specific cases. Under these circumstances, Dastur has reviewed the permits required for the installation of project facilities and listed the statutory requirements for the facilities, as well as the internal or corporate approvals needed for the host site to initiate construction for the project and prepared a permitting study and review (Attachment 4). Subtask 4.5 Hazard and Operability Review (HAZOP) Dastur conducted a HAZOP study for the project. This study is limited to the system boundary envisaged in this project. Dastur prepared the P&ID for WGS & BOP and reviewed the P&ID of the carbon capture island prepared by ION and their inter-linkages to identify hazards associated with the proposed installation and conducted cause and consequence analysis due to deviation from the design intent by application of standard guidelines. Based on HAZOP study findings, Dastur proposed preventive/corrective measures for the safe implementation and operation of the plant units. HAZOP study outcome has been described in Attachment 5. Task 5.0 Costing The cost estimation for this project was done according to NETL (National Energy Technology Laboratory) guidelines defined in “Quality Guidelines for Energy System Studies (QGESS)” published by NETL and AACE 16R-90 (Conducting Technical and Economic Evaluations – As Applied for the Process and Utility Industries). Cost estimation for this project is consistent with the requirement and consideration for the Association for the Advancement of Cost Engineering (AACE) Class 4. Subtask 5.1 Capital Cost of Major Equipment including Construction Cost Dastur has estimated the capital cost of the major units like water gas shift unit, CO capture unit, 2 compressors, steam and power generation unit, etc., based on either budgetary quotation of the individual units or the cost of similar installed facilities. Dastur has reviewed the budgetary offers from multiple vendors and selected them based on cost, operating parameters, past performance, reference list, etc. The construction costs are estimated based on AACE 16R-90 guidelines and/or the parametric method basis. Subtask 5.2 Capital Cost for BOP Facilities Including Construction Cost The capital cost for the balance of plant facilities, like utility systems, water systems, electrical systems, instrumentation, etc., has been estimated based on vendor data, in-house data, and similar installed facilities. All the auxiliary facilities for the project are considered based on a standalone basis within the project boundary limit. Subtask 5.3 Project Indirect Cost The project’s indirect cost includes pre-production cost, inventory capital, financing cost, owner’s other costs, interest during construction, and other applicable costs. The same has been estimated based on NETL's “Quality Guidelines for Energy System Studies: Cost Estimation Methodology for NETL Assessments of Power Plant Performance.” Dastur has assessed the Owner’s cost by evaluating existing facilities or infrastructure. Subsequently, the cost for modification/augmentation of existing systems has been considered in Owner’s cost. Pre-FEED Study 6 DE-FE0031937 / 0001 Subtask 5.4 Operating and Maintenance Cost
